dispatches.feedback_brief:
Apply four mechanical corrections, all localized:

1. I-AA-002 (MAJOR) — Backend Design evidence/updates validator-exclusion mechanism. ADR-0044 §Decision §4 + §Implementation Guidance commit that files under Issues/<topic>/evidence/ and Issues/<topic>/updates/ are explicitly excluded from FR-7's validator extension. Blueprint v2 Backend Design does NOT specify the mechanism. Verified empirically: validate_pipeline_frontmatter.py currently emits a minor finding on agent-roster-impact-matrix.md; the same finding will persist post-FR-9 migration into Issues/per-agent-design-evaluation-gap/evidence/ unless the validator extension adds a path-prefix skip.

Required changes:
- Blueprint §Backend Design §Service/Module Layout (around line 856): add a sentence specifying the path-prefix skip — e.g., 'Before doc_type_category dispatch, the validator early-returns an empty finding list for any path matching Issues/<topic>/(evidence|updates)/, honoring ADR-0044 §Decision §4.'
- Blueprint §Backend Design §Corrected Pseudocode Reference (lines 887-921): add a 2-3 line pseudocode block at the top of validate_pipeline_frontmatter.py's outer dispatch (currently lines 365-371) — e.g., 'if "/Issues/" in str(path) and ("/evidence/" in str(path) or "/updates/" in str(path)): return []'. The pseudocode should match the chosen mechanism (recommended: outer-dispatch early-return at lines 365-371, rather than unknown-category branch at lines 304-312, because the former is unambiguous and does not require doc_type_category to know about the path).
- Blueprint §Data Contract OR §Field Propagation Map: add a one-line entry — e.g., 'Skipped path family: Issues/<topic-slug>/(evidence|updates)/** — emit no findings regardless of frontmatter shape (per ADR-0044 §Decision §4).'
- Verify that ADR-0044's claim 'fully implemented by FR-7' is now true after this fix; if not, escalate.

2. I-AA-003 (MINOR) — Interface Change Matrix 'or'-wording stale. Blueprint line 469 currently reads: 'Adds fourth elif branch keyed on doc_type ∈ ISSUE_DOC_TYPES (or extends doc_type_category to return "issue" per Q-BE-5 / I-DR-BE-005 resolution)'. Backend Design §Service/Module Layout line 856 already chose the second mechanism. Replace the line-469 phrasing with: 'extends doc_type_category (lines 147-154) to return "issue" when doc_type ∈ ISSUE_DOC_TYPES; adds an elif category == "issue" branch inside validate_pipeline_artifact'. Removes the false-options ambiguity.

3. I-AA-004 (MINOR) — ADR-0047 frontmatter applies_to four-vs-five. ADR-0047 frontmatter line 14 currently reads: 'the four project firsts this run introduces (disable-model-invocation skill, .claude/hooks/ directory, settings.json hooks block, runtime Read/Glob KB-load pattern for sub-agents)'. The ADR's own Decision §5 (line 73) enumerates five firsts (adding 'first 5-state lifecycle vocabulary'). This is incomplete propagation of cycle-1's I-DR-BP-001 fix (Blueprint complexity_rationale was updated to five but ADR-0047 was not). Amend line 14 to enumerate five firsts: 'the five project firsts this run introduces (disable-model-invocation skill, .claude/hooks/ directory, settings.json hooks block, runtime Read/Glob KB-load pattern for sub-agents, 5-state lifecycle vocabulary distinct from ADR-0008's 4-state intra-pipeline ledger and ADR-0032's 3-tier per-doc-type vocabulary)'. Aligns ADR-0047 frontmatter with its own Decision §5 and with the Blueprint's complexity_rationale.

4. I-AA-005 (MINOR) — Blueprint AC-FR-11-c citation error. Blueprint line 294 (the I-DR-BP-006 resolution note) cites 'AC-FR-11-a/b/c'. PRD-v2 defines only AC-FR-11-a and AC-FR-11-b (verified by grep). Replace 'AC-FR-11-a/b/c' with 'AC-FR-11-a/b' at line 294. One-character drop.

DO NOT modify:
- The ADR placement of the 7 new ADRs (I-AA-001 is a user-escalation; await orchestrator's user-decision result before touching ADR locations or authoring any superseding ADR).
- The Blueprint frontmatter doc_type field (I-AA-006 is deferred per the auditor's own resolution).
- Any audit-positive observation (I-AA-007..I-AA-010 are INFO; no action).

AFTER all four edits, ensure the supersession discipline is honored: new blueprint version filename and predecessor field updated; ADR-0047 edit captured in the ADR's change history or a one-line amendment note in the ADR body (if the ADR template supports it).

user_escalations.summary: Seven new ADRs (ADR-0044..0050) authored at working/feature/<slug>/adrs/ contradict ADR-0036 (accepted) which mandates single-location placement at repo-root /adrs/. The same drift is acknowledged as a pipeline-wide issue tracked separately in Issues/adr-placement-rootcause/analysis.md; the PRD's Won't-Have section excludes resolving this drift in this run.
user_escalations.why_user_judgment_required: Choosing among the three resolution paths is a scope-trade-off question (resolve the drift inline vs maintain the boundary of this feature's intent), not an artifact-quality question. The reconciler cannot decide whether resolving the drift here expands scope beyond the user's Gate-2 intent approval. The user previously acknowledged this drift as a separate feature concern.

options.label: Option A — accept drift with explicit user-token
options.description: Leave the 7 ADRs at working/feature/<slug>/adrs/. Add a user_token_for_adr_placement_deviation: "<token>" field to Blueprint frontmatter. Add a one-paragraph rationale in Blueprint §References explaining the deviation references the separate drift-remediation feature and the user-approved deferral.
options.trade_off: Preserves the Won't-Have boundary cleanly. Leaves a documented inconsistency between Blueprint and ADR-0036 until the separate drift-remediation feature runs.
options.downstream_agent_work: design-composer adds frontmatter field + §References paragraph (bundle into the existing cycle-2 dispatch).

options.label: Option B — move the 7 ADRs to /adrs/
options.description: Move ADR-0044..0050 from working/feature/<slug>/adrs/ to /adrs/ at repo root. Update cross-references in Blueprint, synthesis, and any layer doc that points to working-feature ADR paths.
options.trade_off: Clean brief-honor resolution; honors ADR-0036 verbatim. Partially pre-empts the separate drift-remediation feature (this run will have resolved the drift for its own ADRs but not for prior runs' ADRs).
options.downstream_agent_work: design-composer (or orchestrator) moves files; updates Blueprint cross-references and synthesis claim; re-runs reviewer Gate 0 on the moved ADRs to confirm no metadata regression.

options.label: Option C — author superseding ADR amending ADR-0036
options.description: design-composer authors a new ADR (e.g., ADR-0051) per ADR-0005 explicitly permitting feature-scoped ADR authoring during pipeline runs, with deliverable-packager canonicalizing to /adrs/ at run completion. ADR-0036 supersedes to the new ADR; the 7 new ADRs remain in place.
options.trade_off: Most architecturally satisfying; aligns the operational convention with the formal record. Pre-empts the separate drift-remediation feature entirely by absorbing it into this run, expanding scope beyond Gate-2 intent.
options.downstream_agent_work: design-composer authors ADR-0051 (per FR-5); Blueprint and synthesis claim updated to cite ADR-0051; reviewer Gate 0 on the new ADR; full re-validation cascade.

user_escalations.reconciler_recommendation_rationale: Per discipline (Phase 2 categorization rule: 'When in doubt: escalate'), the reconciler does not recommend among options where each has materially different scope-impact and the user has previously expressed scope boundaries via PRD Won't-Have.
